run_meteor_quality_estimation: run the meteor quality estimation tool on translation files with configurable repeat times and language
read_translations_from_file: read translation files and group segments by repeat count into a dictionary structure
generate_meteor_input_files: generate temporary reference and machine translation input files from grouped translations for meteor scoring
run_meteor_jar_scoring: run the meteor java jar to score machine translations against references with custom parameters
parse_meteor_output_scores: parse meteor output files and compute average scores across all segment combinations
